note: Every recipe of TF's data pack (any namespace) and every twilightforest:* recipe: type, serializer, getResultItem (id, count), isSpecial, width/height of shaped recipes, cookingTime/experience of cooking recipes, getIngredients() (each the item ids of Ingredient#getItems in order, tags expanded; [] = empty slot) and data: the recipe encoded with its serializer's codec (the recipe JSON as TF loaded it: drying time, modifier keys, scepter repair durability, ...; object keys sorted). probe (travellers' gear modifier recipes, whose result depends on the input): the first item of each ingredient crafted with the recipe. probes: recipes whose result is code, crafted from the inputs of tools/oracle/spec.json: matches, and when it matches the assembled result and the remaining items. Stacks: "" = empty, an item id = one item without components, else ItemStack's codec {count, components (the patch over the item's defaults), id}. notLoaded lists recipe files of TF's data pack the recipe manager did not load (their load conditions failed, e.g. compat recipes of absent mods).
